headline: Brazilian Steelmakers CSN and Gerdau Plummet in New York Trading
summary: Brazilian steelmakers CSN and Gerdau plunged 22.73% and 6.86% respectively in New York on Monday amid broader market turmoil in Brazil.
why: Major Brazilian industrial exporters are heavily influenced by domestic macroeconomic conditions and currency swings while trading globally.

impacts.name: Gerdau
impacts.why: Broader economic sell-offs in Brazil directly impacted the New York-traded ADRs of domestic steel producers.

why_moved: Spillover effects from the country-wide equity sell-off severely pressured industrial and materials sector valuations.
